{{Quote|This test has two outcomes. A pass or a fail. If they pass, the girls leave. If we want them to stay… Mm?|Naasa to Mother Aniseya and Mother Koril, regarding Mae and Osha Aniseya|audio=Naasa-PassOrFail-Destiny.flac|<ref name="Destiny" />}}
'''Naasa''' was a [[Jumurra]] [[Gender|female]] who was a [[witch]] [[Elder (title)|elder]], [[augur]], and [[advisor]] within [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]]'s [[Brendok coven|coven]] on its adopted [[homeworld]] [[Brendok]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[148 BBY]], Naasa attended a meeting of Mother Aniseya's advisors after a [[Brendok four|group]] of [[Jedi]] [[Mission to Brendok|sought]] out the Mother's [[twin]] [[Aniseya family|daughters]], [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]], and gained Aniseya's permission to test them as potential Jedi.

The elder suggested that only passing the test resulted in the twins leaving with the Jedi, and so Mother Aniseya instructed her daughters to intentionally fail, although Verosha disobeyed this order. Naasa later agreed with coven members who said that Verosha should not be allowed to leave shortly before Jedi infiltrated the [[fortress]] in search of the twins. Naasa then took part in casting a spell to [[Possession|possess]] the [[Wookiee]] Jedi [[Kelnacca]], forcing him to fight his comrades until [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] broke the possession, [[Death|killing]] Naasa in the process.

==Biography==
===Sage advice===
{{Quote|Gather my advisors.|Mother Aniseya tells Mother Koril to gather Naasa and the others|audio=Aniseya-Advisors-Destiny.flac|<ref name="Destiny" />}}
[[File:MountMopu-Destiny.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A curved fortress sits atop Mount Mopu on Brendok, built into the mountain's peak. Other mountains our visible in the background as well as the moons Ashlasi and Bogaro in the cloudy sky.|Elder Naasa and her exiled coven lived in a fortress on their adopted homeworld Brendok.]]
Naasa was a [[Jumurra]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Gender|female]] in the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[witch]] [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]], serving as an [[Elder (title)|elder]],<ref name="Destiny" /> [[augur]],<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and [[advisor]] to the group's leader in its [[Brendok fortress|fortress]]<ref name="Destiny" /> on their adopted [[homeworld]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> [[Brendok]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Destiny" /> In [[148 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> Naasa was believed to be the eldest of the roughly fifty-four witches who lived in the coven.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Death" /> a [[Brendok four|group]] of four [[Jedi]] [[Mission to Brendok|came]] to the [[fortress]] seeking Mother Aniseya's [[twin]] [[Aniseya family|daughters]], [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]].<ref name="Destiny" />

After a confrontation at the twins' [[Rite of Ascension]] ritual, the Jedi requested that Mother Aniseya give permission for her daughters—who were being trained by the witches—to be tested to become Jedi. The coven's leader agreed that they would take the test the following [[Local day|day]], then called a meeting of her advisors in the [[fortress common room]] after the Jedi had left the fortress. Naasa attended the meeting but sat on the common room's steps while the others present stood. Mother [[Koril]] suggested that the coven attack the Jedi, but others objected and Aniseya ultimately rejected the idea, stating that the test would be taken.<ref name="Destiny" />

[[File:KorilNaasaAniseya-Destiny.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Mother Aniseya and Koril look to Naasa as she stands between them in the common room of the coven's fortress common room on Brendok.|Naasa acted as an advisor to Mother Aniseya on Brendok.]]
Koril then questioned what would happen when the Jedi discovered the twins' origin, at which point Naasa interjected, slowly standing as the other advisors turned to listen. As<ref name="Destiny" /> she<ref name="Databank" /> slowly moved toward Koril and Mother Aniseya, the elder pointed out that the test could be passed or failed, with only the pass result leading to the twins being taken away by the Jedi.<ref name="Destiny" />

===Collapse of the coven===
{{Listen3|Witches-TranceChant-Choice.flac|the witches' chant|Naasa and the other witches chant while casting a spell on Kelnacca}}
[[File:WitchDiscussion-Choice.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=In the coven's fortress common room on Brendok, Mother Aniseya's twelve advisors stand in a row in front of her with Naasa at the end.|Naasa agreed with those who wished to prevent Verosha Aniseya leaving the coven.]]
After the meeting, Mother Aniseya instructed Verosha and Mae-ho to purposefully fail the test that the Jedi would give them, which Mae-ho gladly did. Verosha, however, wished to become a Jedi and so passed the test.<ref name="Destiny" /> Naasa sat on the steps of the common room and listened as Verosha informed her [[Parent|mother]] that she wished to go with the Jedi. After Verosha left the room, Naasa and the other witches present rose to discuss whether she should be allowed to leave.<ref name="Choice">{{Acolyte|Choice}}</ref>

Several members of the coven objected to Verosha being allowed to join the Jedi, and Naasa nodded in agreement with them. Mother Aniseya overruled them, prioritizing Verosha's wishes. Meanwhile, the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Sol]] and the [[Padawan]] [[Torbin]] had begun to infiltrate the fortress to rescue the twins while Koril called for the coven to prepare to defend itself. After Aniseya was [[Death|killed]] during a confrontation with the Jedi in the fortress's [[Rite of Ascension courtyard|courtyard]], Naasa and a group of other witches began a chant while seated together in the common room to<ref name="Choice" /> cast a spell<ref name="Choice AD">{{Acolyte|Choice}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> that [[Possession|possessed]] the [[Wookiee]] Jedi [[Kelnacca]] as he arrived at the fortress. Sat with their [[Limb|palms]] facing up and their [[eye]]s fully [[Color|black]], the witches swayed<ref name="Choice" /> and mumbled the chant in a trance-like state of concentration while casting the spell.<ref name="Choice AD" /> 

[[File:WitchTrance-Choice.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=With Naasa at the center, fourteen coven members sit in a trance-like state, their eyes black and their palms upturned as they sit on stepped seating.|Naasa helped cast a spell to control Kelnacca.]]
Kelnacca fought against Sol and Torbin until [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] arrived and [[Force power|used]] [[the Force]] to end his possession,<ref name="Choice" /> mentally cutting the Thread controlling him. This caused a psychic whiplash<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> that resulted in the death<ref name="Death" /> of Naasa and the other witches with her,<ref name="Choice" /> who collapsed into a lifeless heap.<ref name="Choice AD" /> Sol rescued Verosha from a [[fire]] spreading in the fortress, and as they exited the structure, the pair came upon the bodies of the witches who had perished before they left.<ref name="Destiny" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:ElderNaasa-Destiny.png|thumb|left|275px|alt=Naasa stands in the Brendok common room with a staff and purple robes.|Naasa used her divination skills to aid her coven and try to guide them toward a brighter horizon.]]
By 148 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> Naasa was wizened and elderly,<ref name="Destiny AD">{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> requiring a [[cane]] to walk and struggling to stand during the meeting in the common room.<ref name="Destiny" /> Due to her age, the elder's primary concern was for the future of her coven, within which she stood out for her wisdom.<ref name="Databank" /> Although Mother Aniseya cherished Naasa's divination skills, the elder always made sure to respectfully provide only options and insights, never directives.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> She did however hope to steer her sisters toward a brighter horizon that was free of outside interference.<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=#37 - Elder Naasa|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/544247/cid/31223519/2025-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-37-Elder-Naasa}}</ref> The witch had tan skin, brown eyes, and stood 1.75 [[meter]]s (five [[foot|feet]], nine inches) tall.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Naasa was able to divine [[Force vision|visions]] of the future by examining the Thread—the witches' name for the Force—and extrapolating from its vibrations. She could then put the visions into context with the insight provided by her deep knowledge and experience.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
After the Rite of Ascension,<ref name="Destiny" /> Naasa wore a densely corded gray-purple [[turban]] that symbolized intricacy of thought and darker purple [[robe]]s patterned with a squared embroidery that symbolized discrete events amid perpetual recursion. The [[Clothing|robes]] also had a golden trim.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

Her stylized "[[wing case]]" [[necklace]] had many flat or thin golden adornments, and she had a golden [[ring]] on each index finger and another on her left ring finger. Naasa's walking stick was brown and festooned with talismans.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> At the time of her death, she wore a simpler gray-purple robe with a blue shawl and a necklace of dirty white adornments.<ref name="Choice" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayal and fabrication===
{{Quote|One of the most fun and challenging creatures I've had the pleasure to mechanize on #StarWars #TheAcolyte ! A tight space to work in as always but super rewarding to see her featured up close and personal, even just for a scene.|Nicolas Ferrard|<ref name="Ferrard">{{Instagram|username=obviouslycookies|url=p/C-frXpNqbDg|name=[[Nicolas Ferrard]]|date=2024-08-10|quote=One of the most fun and challenging creatures I've had the pleasure to mechanize on #StarWars #TheAcolyte ! A tight space to work in as always but super rewarding to see her featured up close and personal, even just for a scene. Practical animatronic head worn by Barbara Fadden, Puppeteered by @claireroiharvey and @mantisrobot sculpted by @stef_cordioli painted by @hensvensson Moulded by Kenny Wilson and his crew Fabrication by Sherry Hazzard Hair by @jodicorpe and her crew #animatronics #animatronic #creature #specialeffects|archiveurl=https://archive.is/KZHcQ|archivefile=File:NicolasFerrard-Naasa-Instagram.png}}</ref>}}
[[File:ElderNaasa-AcolyteVG.png|thumb|right|200px|alt=Elder Naasa, leant on her walking stick and dressed in her purple robes and turban.|Naasa's costume was designed by Jennifer Bryan.]]
Naasa first appeared and was identified in "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]],"<ref name="Destiny" /> the third episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 11]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, the character was first revealed in a trailer for the show released on [[May 18]], 2024.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|Py_IYpy4IlQ|The Acolyte | Plan | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}}</ref> 

[[Jake Lunt Davies]] designed the character,<ref name="Cordioli">{{Instagram|username=stef_cordioli|url=p/C85LaPZKt81|name=[[Stefano Cordioli]]|date=2024-07-01|quote=Another character  I had the pleasure to sculpt  for #theacolyte.  Designed  by @jakeluntdavies. The head is  fully animatronic,  built by @obviouslycookies that crushed it as always. Animatronic Supervisor  @hoegengustav. The animatronic head was Worn by Barbara Fadden, on set dialogue puppeteered by @claireroiharvey and Matt D on eyes and brow :). Thanks so much 🙏 Hopefully in the future ill be able to post the work in progress. #disney #disneyplus #starwarsitalia #starwars #theacolyte #creatures #creaturecantina #osha #andor #conceptdesign #scifi|archivefile=File:StefanoCordioli-Naasa-Instagram.png}}</ref> producing a concept art sketch titled "Coven Elder,"<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref> and [[Nicolas Ferrard]] built<ref name="Cordioli" /> and mechanised the animatronic mask, which was then sculpted by [[Stefano Cordioli]], molded by [[Kenny Wilson]] and his crew, and painted by [[Henrik Svensson]]. [[Sherri Hazzard]] carried out the fabrication, and [[Jodi Corpe]] and her crew were responsible for the character's hair. Naasa's mask was puppeteered by [[Matt Denton]] and [[Claire Roi Harvey]] with [[Derek Arnold]] as CFX coordinator and [[Colin Purves]] as dep. Harvey also provided the character's dialogue on set.<ref name="Harvey">{{Instagram|username=claireroiharvey
|url=p/C_U5ZqMoze9|name=[[Claire Roi Harvey]]|date=2024-08-31|quote=Had to give this beautiful creature from #theacolyte a spot on the grid… A joy to puppeteer her on set with @mantisrobot (with @nimloc being the best dep ever) and of COURSE epic suit performer and golden human Barbara Fadden absolutely nailing Elder Naasa from the inside. Not an easy feat! I was stoked to have been asked to puppeteer a witch 🧹(as I’m sure you can imagine 😉 @canadianderek ) *flies off into the night*Shout out to all of the epic Witches of Brendok for the on set compliments, curiousity about animatronics/puppetry, and the big supportive sister vibes on set ✌️ special mention: our brilliant director Kogonada for having such trust in the performance team for this creature. All of these characters take big teams of folks from Neal Scanlans team to bring to the screen 🧹 ✨ FOLLOW THEM ALL ✨ 🧹 Practical animatronic suit performance by THE Barbara Fadden Puppeteered by @claireroiharvey and @mantisrobot ( & @nimloc) Mechanised by the brilliant @obviouslycookies On set dialogue @claireroiharvey CFX coordinator @canadianderek sculpted by @stef_cordioli painted by @hensvensson Moulded by Kenny Wilson and his crew Fabrication by Sherri Hazzard Hair by @jodicorpe and her crew ADR @shelbyhyoung #cfx #animatronics #practicaleffects #animatronic #creature #theacolyte #puppetry #puppeteer #starwarscreatures #mtfbwy #creatureeffects #witchesofbrendok|archiveurl=https://archive.is/HSpgt|archivefile=File:ClaireRoiHarvey-Naasa1-Instagram.png|archivefile2=File:ClaireRoiHarvey-Naasa2-Instagram.png|archivefile3=File:ClaireRoiHarvey-Naasa3-Instagram.png}}</ref>

The character was physically portrayed by [[Barbara Fadden]]<ref name="Destiny" /> and voiced by [[Shelby Young]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|shelby_young|status/1801405642273603858|[[Shelby Young]]|quote=so grateful to have lent my voice to elder naasa #theacolyte|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Eg1Fl}}</ref> Ferrard described her as one of the most fun and challenging creatures he had worked on,<ref name="Ferrard" /> and Harvey claimed that she had been a joy to puppeteer and was especially pleased to puppeteer a witch.<ref name="Harvey" />

===Costume===
Naasa's outfit was designed by costume designer [[Jennifer Bryan]], and three separate costume design concepts were produced by [[Eleanor Barlow]] in [[2022]]: one showing her in her full purple and gold robes, one showing her in simpler mauve garments, and one showing her with her arm in a sling.<ref name="Artstation">{{ArtStation|subdomain=ebarlow|username=ebarlow|url=projects/XJe9nY|name=[[Eleanor Barlow]]|text=Force Witch Elder Illustrations for Acolyte, S1. Costume Design by Jennifer Bryan}}</ref> The coven's outfits were made from nine hundred meters of raw fabric that was initially more of a bright fuchsia before being meticulously dyed to a royal purple according to Bryan.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=destiny-trivia-gallery-the-acolyte|text="Destiny" Trivia Gallery | The Acolyte}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> The interior scenes on Brendok were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Location">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/lucasfilm-on-location-the-acolyte|text=Lucasfilm on Location: ''The Acolyte''}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref>
